title: Baidu ERNIE 5.1 Large Language Model
summary: Baidu's latest flagship model released in May 2026, focusing on high parameter efficiency and agentic reasoning. It is currently the top-ranked Chinese model globally, achieving frontier performance with significantly lower training costs.
research_notes: Ranks 4th globally on Arena Search and 1st among Chinese models. Designed to optimize performance under hardware constraints and US chip export controls.

evolution.summary: Follows ERNIE 5.0, shifting from massive parameter scale (2.4T) to a more efficient 800B architecture via the Once-For-All framework. It features a new asynchronous reinforcement learning pipeline and enhanced four-stage post-training.
